summary: Portugal allocates grid capacity and support through auctions, plans 10 GW of offshore wind capacity, and funds self-consumption and storage. Congested grid capacity is the central constraint.

access.reason: The government runs auctions to reserve grid injection capacity and allocate support, and plans 10 GW of offshore wind capacity through auctions.

ownership.reason: Portugal imposes no exchange controls, and no foreign ownership cap on generation was found.

build.reason: Limited and congested grid capacity is the central constraint, and securing new network capacity is slow and costly.

stability.reason: The updated National Energy and Climate Plan 2030 sets targets, and no retroactive cut was found.

direction.reason: No major change to auction rules was found in the period reviewed.

access.reason: EU recovery funds and the Environmental Fund support self-consumption, storage and efficiency projects.

build.reason: Grid congestion also affects connection of consumption sites in high-demand zones.

stability.reason: National plan targets support self-consumption, and no retroactive change was found.

direction.reason: No major change was found in the period reviewed.
